Without folder, use pm_folder(): folder PaleoMapR home folder (Documents Windows). setup: makes small Python environment pyGPlates (plate rotations) using tool uv, downloads Python 3.12 . stored R user-data folder (Windows: C:\Users\<>\AppData\Roaming\R\data\R\paleomapeditor\venv) shared working folders; downloads data/ PaleoDEMs 0–540 Ma (~280 MB, EarthByte), PaleoCoastlines (~75 MB, Zenodo), PBDB Macrostrat records sea-level curve, builds table database records; downloads HadCM3L climate files chosen ages (~30 MB per age, University Bristol); builds fossil-corrected grids chosen ages (1–2 minutes per age per core; plate model downloaded models/). download fails interrupted, run setup : finished steps files kept. ages? default Silurian ages 445–415 Ma (30 minutes). pm_setup(ages = "") prepares 109 ages, 0–540 Ma (several hours, ~3 GB climate files); pm_setup(ages = c(300, 305, 310)) seq(250, 200, = -5) (matched nearest map age). launcher, run SETUP.bat SETUP.bat 300 305 310 command window. age also works directly editor: choose press Rebuild age.

text: Figure tab settings rendered maps left, interactive Figure map right (shows chosen layer overlays; move zoom choose area zoomed-figures) rendered figure , download buttons. Render map Map editor uses settings. Map colours: topography climate layer: precipitation, near-surface air temperature (brought map heights lapse rate), precipitation − evaporation, runoff, freshwater sea (P − E plus rivers routed map), river water, sea fresher saltier, sea-surface salinity, - downwelling, mixed-layer depth, surface O2 saturation, surface density, sea ice. Figure layout: whole map, zoomed-area , composite (whole earth zoom-, joined lines). Season / month: annual mean, DJF, MAM, JJA, SON one month; Four seasons puts DJF–SON one page one colour scale. Climate: HadCM3L + local correction adjusts model fields corrected geography (land fraction around point, sea upwind, relief, height), learned model run; HadCM3L run shows model unchanged. drawn: reefs, evaporites, glacial deposits, points, borders coastlines, equator, ice front, original PaleoCoastlines shoreline, north arrow, scale bar, wind current arrows, sea ice, rivers, dashed outline geography differs much model’s (least reliable climate). Projection (whole maps): Mollweide, Robinson, Equal Earth, Winkel tripel, Hammer, Eckert IV, Plate Carrée, orthographic globe, south north polar. Zoomed-areas use equal-area projection. Quality: draft (150 dpi, fast), standard (220 dpi), high (300 dpi, zoom-ins refined 8×, slow). Localities: labelled (palaeo-latitude); centre map locality (follows locality time) longitude. Render figure writes PNG vector PDF maps/ shows result; Download PDF / PNG saves copy want. PDF every label line separate, editable object (Illustrator, Inkscape, Affinity); shaded relief image.

title: PaleoMapR 0.1.0 (alpha)
text: First public release, testing feedback. Buttons, defaults file names may still change. paleogeographic map editor (standalone version 2026-10-26) R package: run_app() starts , pm_setup() prepares working folder (Python pyGPlates, open data sets, HadCM3L climate files corrected grids chosen ages), pm_load() gives functions scripts. Windows launcher (PaleoMapR-launcher.zip release page): SETUP.bat installs everything, prepares data launcher folder puts desktop icon. Map editor: every PaleoDEM age 0–540 Ma, four plate models, PBDB Macrostrat records, points (marine, deeper shelf, evaporite, terrestrial, reef, glacial), excluded records, undo, rebuilding fossil-corrected grid statistics. Figure tab: many projections, whole map / zoomed-/ composite, localities, symbols, scale bar north arrow, HadCM3L climate layers (run, local correction map), wind current arrows, rivers, sea ice. Faster map switching Figure redraws (cached editor maps relief shading). tab version, works cite, daily update check “Update restart”, button closes editor. table database records rebuilt classification rules change (checksum), every update package.
